# Master Document 33 — Control-to-Document Index

**Controls covered:** Indexing artifact only — supports P16-01 (Core document set complete), P16-04 (Documentation current with released version)
**Phase:** 16 — Documentation
**Status:** Draft — generated by scanning every `**Controls covered:**` header across `docs/`; regenerate whenever a Master Document's header changes

## 1. Purpose
This is a single, machine-and-human-readable index mapping every EADC control ID (against the 157-control set from the 10 August 2026 EADC Compliance Audit) to the specific document(s) that address it. It exists so an automated compliance checker — or a person doing a manual pass — can look up "what governs control X" without scanning all 30+ Master Documents individually. It supplements, rather than replaces, Master Document 21 (Documentation Register), which indexes documents by number; this index goes the other direction, control ID to document.

## 2. How this was generated
Every `.md` file under `docs/` was scanned for its `**Controls covered:**` header line, and each `CONTROL-ID (description)` pair in that line was extracted as one row below. Where a control's evidence lives across multiple documents (e.g. C0-06, spanning the governance-gate document, the security-architecture document, and the release-evidence-pack document), all are listed. Two controls are marked **Not Applicable** per the original audit (P6A-05 mobile spec, P6B-01 — no mobile app or separate conversational-AI product exists in Sonic's scope). Four controls are marked **Unaddressed** — genuine gaps, not indexing errors — see §4.

## 4. Known gaps (not indexed anywhere — real, not a scan error)
| Control | Name | Why it's not addressed |
|---|---|---|
| EV5-01 | Cyber/AI/Mobile Extensibility Reserved | No document currently scopes future cyber/AI/mobile extensibility reservation — not evaluated in this pass |
| P12-01 | Quality Gates & Acceptance Checklist | Overlaps Master Doc 25's release-readiness checklist but was never formally tagged/scoped as satisfying this specific control |
| P12-02 | Continuous Improvement Process | No formal continuous-improvement process (distinct from EV6-01's gap-detection mechanism) has been defined |
| P24-02 | Predictive Analytics & Decision Intelligence | No predictive-analytics capability exists or is planned; not addressed |

These four should be either explicitly scoped (with a document assigned) or formally accepted as out-of-scope with rationale — leaving them silently absent is what this index is designed to prevent.

## 5. Outcome
- [x] All 157 controls from the 10 August 2026 audit accounted for: 151 mapped to a specific document, 2 marked Not Applicable, 4 flagged as genuine unaddressed gaps
- [x] Controls previously covered in a document's body text but missing from its header tag (EV1-01, EV2-01, EV3-01, PB-03, P6A-06, P10-04, P11-02) were fixed at the source — both the header tags and, where content was only inferred rather than written, the missing body content — rather than papering over the gap in this index alone
- [ ] The 4 genuine gaps in §4 assigned an owner and either closed or formally accepted as out-of-scope
- [ ] Regenerate this index whenever a Master Document's `**Controls covered:**` header changes — it is a point-in-time snapshot, not a live query
